title: PReMISE: Policy Rubrics as Measurement Specifications for LLM Judges
abstract: arXiv:2605.30803v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM judges are increasingly used to evaluate open-ended responses, but their scores depend strongly on the rubrics that condition them. A vague rubric asking for a response to be ``helpful and factual'' can reward polished answers that invent facts or violate user intent. We treat reusable rubrics as measurement specifications: changing the rubric changes the response quality measurement induced by a fixed judge. We introduce PReMISE, a framework that, given pairwise human-preference data, (i) discovers a policy-level rubric set, and (ii) audits any rubric set under LLM-judge use along four axes: structural adequacy, reliability, preference fit, and adversarial robustness. Across rubric sources no raw source is simultaneously reliable, preference-predictive, and adversarially robust; and high inter-rater agreement does not imply low exploitability. PReMISE is the only rubric source to score non-trivially on applicability, specificity

translated_title: PReMISE：作为LLM裁判测量规范的策略评分细则
translated_abstract: LLM裁判（LLM-as-a-Judge）正被越来越多地用于评估开放式回答，但其评分在很大程度上取决于约束它的评分细则。一个模糊的评分细则（例如要求回答“有帮助且符合事实”）可能会奖励那些措辞精美却编造事实或违背用户意图的回答。我们将可复用的评分细则视为测量规范：改变评分细则就会改变由固定裁判所诱导的回答质量测量。我们提出了PReMISE框架，在给定成对人类偏好数据的情况下，该框架能够（i）发现策略层面的评分细则集合，并（ii）从四个维度审计LLM裁判使用下的任意评分细则集合：结构充分性、可靠性、偏好拟合度和对抗鲁棒性。跨评分细则来源的实验表明，没有任何原始来源能同时具备可靠性、偏好预测性和对抗鲁棒性；且评分者之间的高度一致并不意味着评分细则难以被钻空子。PReMISE是唯一在适用性、特异性等方面获得非平凡得分的评分细则来源（摘要原文在此处似有截断）。
tldr: 提出PReMISE框架，将策略评分细则视为LLM裁判的测量规范，可从人类偏好数据中发现评分细则集合，并从结构充分性、可靠性、偏好拟合度和对抗鲁棒性四个维度审计任意评分细则，研究发现没有现成的评分细则来源能同时做到可靠、可预测偏好且对抗鲁棒。
en_tdlr: PReMISE treats policy rubrics as measurement specifications for LLM judges, discovering rubric sets from pairwise human preference data and auditing any rubric set along four axes—structural adequacy, reliability, preference fit, and adversarial robustness—showing that no existing rubric source is simultaneously reliable, preference-predictive, and adversarially robust.
